promise: The Seine will be swimmable for the 2024 Paris Olympics, and "we will swim in it" (I will swim in the Seine in 2024).
description: Following a 2018 EUR1.4B cleanup plan, Macron repeatedly pledged in 2023-2024 that the Seine would host Olympic swimming and that he would personally swim in it. His planned July 31, 2024 swim was cancelled, the men's triathlon was postponed a day over water quality, and several athletes fell ill — but the triathlons and marathon swimming were ultimately held in the river, and the Seine reopened to public swimming in 2025.
evidence: Macron's planned July 2024 Seine swim was cancelled
Men's triathlon postponed due to bacterial contamination (July 30, 2024)
Marathon swimming events took place in the Seine in August 2024; river reopened to swimmers July 2025

review.note: Reported presidential swim had no fixed date, so July 31 cancellation and an Olympic-closing deadline are unsubstantiated. Training cancellations are not cancellation of the competitions. Need separate evidence for Macron personally, Olympic events and 2025 public opening; illness causation must not be implied.

promise: Paris 2024 will be the first Olympic Games with full gender parity on the field of play (as reported).
description: Paris 2024 allocated equal female and male athlete quota places. Equal planned quotas should not be described as proof that the actual number of competing athletes was exactly 5,250 women and 5,250 men.
evidence: IOC's progress report identifies quota places as the parity indicator.

review.note: IOC report measures equal quota places, not proof exactly 5,250 of each gender actually competed. Original March 8 date and actual field require official participation table.

promise: Tesla Robotaxi will be unveiled on 8/8/24
description: Musk announced on April 5, 2024 that Tesla would unveil its robotaxi on August 8. The Cybercab unveiling occurred on October 11, 2024 UTC, later than the stated date.
evidence: Post-event Reuters reporting documents the completed unveiling; the California evening event occurred on October 11 UTC.
